incidents.name: Bug impacting Smart Thermostat Premium and SmartThermostat With voice control

incident_updates.body: The fix has been deployed to the vast majority of affected thermostats. A small number of Smart Thermostat Premium devices are still affected. If your device is running 4.10.7.44, it has not been upgraded due to additional third-party approval or testing required. We are working with third-party partners to resolve the issue for all remaining affected thermostats as soon as possible.
A fix for the bug impacting Smart Thermostat Premium and SmartThermostat with voice control devices that have been rebooted since Aug. 23 has begun rolling out.

We’ve identified a bug impacting Smart Thermostat Premium and SmartThermostat with voice control, which is causing temperatures to read higher than they should. We’re actively working on a fix, and will provide updates as soon as possible on an estimated resolution.
